title: Terrain Brush Point Preview — proposal format example

changes.reason: Illustrates how a proposed performance change is shown. Reducing density changes visual sampling and must be tested against the intended terrain preview.
changes.reproduce: Select Spawn Particles in Grid in Emitter Update, then edit X Count and Y Count.

notes: This is an illustrative UI fixture, not a recommendation and not an instruction to modify the user's emitter.
The live observed emitter uses X Count 64, Y Count 64, Z Count 1, and Spawn Time 0.
